pages.text: $(thing)Common Scab$() ($(o)Streptomyces scabiei$()), bacterium.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() potato, carrot, beetroot, sugar beet.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() soilborne, seedborne.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 10-30 °C (best 22 °C), pH above 5.3.

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 10 years (soil).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 5% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Keep soil pH below 5.3; Irrigate during tuber initiation; Avoid fresh manure and liming before potatoes.
A cosmetic disease that ruins market quality. Strongly suppressed by acidic soil.
